title: The Real Routine of Cristiano Ronaldo
text: What does Cristiano Ronaldo do away from the football cameras? His routine includes exercise, good food and family time. In the morning, he drinks water, takes a short cold bath and takes a shower. He enjoys some morning sunlight before his coffee. To stay fit, he runs on the pitch and lifts weights in the gym. He eats fish, chicken, fruit and vegetables, and tries to avoid sugary foods. Cristiano also takes care of his body through rest. He checks his sleep with a small device on his wrist. His routine is not only about hard training. In his free time, he spends time with his partner and children. Family time helps him relax. He also plays padel with close friends and likes to watch fights. Even a famous football player needs time for other interests and the people he loves.

title: The Real Routine of Lester Martínez
text: Lester Martínez is a professional boxer from Petén, Guatemala. His work takes him far from home, but Guatemala remains an important part of his life. There is also a lighter side to his training. In one video on social media, he dances with Terence Crawford after a practice fight. title: The Scientist Who Saved Millions
text: A Big Problem: Tu Youyou is a scientist in China. She wants to help people. There is a terrible sickness called malaria. Many people get sick, and doctors need a new cure. Looking for Answers: Tu Youyou does not give up. She reads very old books about traditional medicine and plants. She studies day and night, testing hundreds of different herbs to find a solution. Finally, she finds a special plant called sweet wormwood. She discovers a clever way to get the medicine from the plant using cold liquids instead of hot ones, so the medicine does not break. A Great Success: The new medicine is called artemisinin. It works perfectly and cures the sickness. Tu Youyou saves millions of lives around the world and wins the Nobel Prize in Medicine.

multiple_choice.question: Where does Tu Youyou look for answers?
options: In old books about medicine and plants.

multiple_choice.question: Why does she use cold liquids?

To make the plant grow faster.
To change the color of the plant.

true_false.statement: Tu Youyou tests only one herb.

title: Boyan Slat – Cleaning the Oceans
text: Boyan Slat is a young Dutch inventor. When he was sixteen years old, he went diving in Greece and saw more plastic bags than fish in the sea. He felt deeply inspired to solve this global environmental problem. He was determined to make the oceans as clean as a whistle again. Boyan is an active and passionate leader. At the beginning, some people doubted his project. A few critics said he was just a fast talker who wanted easy attention. However, Boyan stayed confident. He designed advanced technology to trap plastic waste in rivers before it reaches the sea. His organization, The Ocean Cleanup, became one of the largest cleaning projects in history. Today, Boyan focuses on constructive solutions for our planet. His floating barriers are more productive than traditional boats with nets, and his team maintains a reliable system in the water. Thanks to his work, many rivers are now cleaner than before.

multiple_choice.question: Why is collecting plastic in rivers important for Boyan’s goal?
options: It stops some plastic from reaching the oceans.
It moves plastic from the oceans into rivers.
It makes more space for fishing boats.

multiple_choice.question: What do Boyan’s actions show about him?
options: He changes his goals whenever people criticize him.
He prefers attention to finding useful solutions.
He continues working even when others doubt him.

true_false.statement: The expression “as clean as a whistle” describes how clean Boyan wants the oceans to be.
The writer agrees with the critics who call Boyan a “fast talker.”
Boyan’s project shows how a personal experience can lead to action on a global problem.

title: Katherine Johnson: A Brilliant Mind
text: Katherine Johnson was an extraordinary African American mathematician who worked for NASA. From an early age, Katherine was an energetic and enthusiastic student. She loved numbers and was always the brightest pupil in her school. During the Space Race, NASA needed experts to calculate complex trajectories for astronauts. Katherine was a visionary thinker with a special talent for geometry. She was remarkably diligent with her calculations. In the 1960s, NASA began using sophisticated electronic machines, but the astronauts trusted Katherine more. Her work was more accurate than the early computers, and she showed the world that women were fully capable of leading scientific missions. Katherine felt deeply accountable for the lives of the astronauts. She was always committed to excellence and checked every equation several times. Even though she became one of the most important figures in space history, she was never big headed; she remained humble and always praised the power of teamwork.

multiple_choice.question: Why did NASA need Katherine Johnson?
options: To calculate complex trajectories for astronauts.

multiple_choice.question: What made Katherine’s calculations special?
options: They were more accurate than the early computers.
They were faster than every modern computer.

true_false.statement: Katherine loved numbers from an early age.

Katherine remained humble and valued teamwork.

title: The bookstore interview
text: Last year, I found a job opening at a new bookstore in my town. It was a wonderful opportunity for me because I love reading. However, more than thirty people applied for the position, so I felt that getting the job would be a long shot. On the morning of the interview, my best friend texted me: "Break a leg!" That message made me smile and gave me confidence. At the store, I met the manager. I stayed calm and focused on every question. We talked about my professional goals for the future. I looked at the manager and said: "I can learn your cash register system fast, and I am a reliable worker who is always on time." At the end of our conversation, I smiled and said: "Thank you for your time. I look forward to hearing from you soon." The next day, the manager called me to say I got the job!

title: The receptionist position
text: Two years ago, I applied for a job as a receptionist at an international hotel. I studied interview questions every evening because I did not want my preparation to go down the drain. During the interview, the front desk manager asked about my previous work. I talked about my customer service experience in a small café. I also explained how my computer skills could help me register guests quickly. Before the meeting, I visited their website and read their mission statement. title: Teamwork at My First Internship
text: Last month, I started an internship at a new office. On my first morning, our manager organized a group project. She explained that building good interpersonal connections is the first step to successful collaboration. At first, I felt nervous, but the team welcomed me warmly. After the first two days, our tasks were running smoothly, and I said to myself, "So far, so good." I wanted to be a helpful team player, so I practiced my communication skills by listening carefully to my coworkers. During our planning meetings, I spoke with calm assertiveness to share my opinions politely. This daily practice gave me more self-confidence. Our project required good time management because we had only three days to prepare the final presentation. When we had doubts about our project plan, we used critical thinking to analyze the situation. We also shared the decision-making process by voting on the best ideas. Working long hours was tiring, but my partner smiled and said, "No pain, no gain!" On Wednesday, a computer error deleted our presentation file. We were suddenly back to square one, but nobody panicked. We applied quick problem-solving methods and recreated the slides together. Thanks to our honest teamwork and strong work ethic, we finished the project before the deadline. At the end of the week, our supervisor gave us constructive feedback and praised our great rapport.

multiple_choice.question: How did the team choose the best ideas?
options: The intern chose all the ideas alone.
They voted on the best ideas.
They asked another company to choose.

multiple_choice.question: What did the team do after the computer error?
options: They waited for a new supervisor.

true_false.statement: The intern listened carefully to coworkers to practice communication skills.

The team finished the project before the deadline.

title: Organic Food: Healthy and Local?
text: Organic food is food that is produced without using chemicals. People buy organic food because they think it is healthy. But is it healthy for the planet? Most people think that organic food is grown by small local farmers. But today, giant food companies like Coca Cola also grow organic food. Many of these big companies still use conventional farming methods that are very bad for the environment, even if the food they grow is more "healthy." Another problem is that a lot of organic food actually comes from faraway countries. Gases from the trucks and airplanes that we use to transport our groceries across continents and countries are a major cause of global warming. What can you do if you want to buy organic food, but you also want to help the environment? One solution is to support your local farmer and encourage him to grow organic food. You can also join a community agriculture program. Members help pay for seeds, fertilizer, water, equipment, etc., and in return, the farm provides a healthy supply of fresh food. So the answer is to buy organic, but also buy local!

multiple_choice.question: Why do many people buy organic food?
options: Because they think it is healthy.

multiple_choice.question: What is one way to help the environment?
options: Buy organic food from faraway countries.

true_false.statement: Organic food always comes from small local farmers.
Transporting food long distances can cause global warming.
A community agriculture program can provide fresh food.
